g.title: CN10
g.text: Gicar power card. Red wire is pin 6. Pins 1, 5, 6 cut back and insulated - never bond them to the Pro 3V3 rail.

g.title: W1
g.text: Gicar side. Plain wire, no components in this run.

g.title: DIVIDER
g.text: R3 220R series on TX. R1 1k plus R2 1.5k divider on RX gives 3.0 V at GPIO44. Source impedance 600R.

g.title: J4
g.text: GaggiMate Pro Rev 1.1 UART port. +5V left unconnected - do not back-feed.
